plan.goal: Exhaustively explore the RideNow mobile fixture, simulating a complete ride booking lifecycle from destination selection to post-ride receipt, while evaluating navigation and small tap target usability.
plan.summary: The exploration will start on the home screen to verify layout and bottom navigation functionality. It will then follow the primary flow: selecting a destination, choosing a ride tier, and completing the simulated trip to reach the rating and receipt screens. Finally, it will ensure secondary tabs like Activity and Account are visited.
assumptions: The application is a Single Page Application (SPA) where all views (booking, ride status, receipt) are rendered dynamically within index.html, likely using data-screen attributes.
Clicking a destination (e.g., 'Work' or a Recent Place) triggers the 'Choose your ride' flow.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets (hamburger menu ☰, notifications 🔔, and recent place arrows →) which may pose usability issues on mobile devices.
State management during the ride lifecycle (ensuring transitions from 'Choose your ride' to 'Trip complete' to 'Rate your driver' work smoothly).

phases.title: Home Screen & Primary Navigation
phases.objective: Validate the initial home screen layout and test the bottom navigation tabs.
key_checks: Click 'Activity', 'Payment', and 'Account' tabs in the bottom bar to verify view switching.
Test the hamburger menu (☰) and notification bell (🔔) to see if menus or modals appear.
exit_criteria: All bottom navigation tabs have been clicked and any resulting state changes observed.

phases.title: Destination Selection
phases.objective: Initiate the booking flow by selecting a destination.
key_checks: Interact with the 'Where to?' input field.
Click one of the quick destination buttons (e.g., '💼 Work' or '✈ PDX Airport').
Verify the UI transitions to the 'Choose your ride' state.
exit_criteria: The 'Choose your ride' heading is visible on screen.

phases.title: Ride Booking & Lifecycle
phases.objective: Complete the ride booking process and progress through the simulated trip.
key_checks: Select a specific ride tier/option if presented.
Click the primary call-to-action to confirm the ride.
Observe the simulated ride progress until the 'Trip complete' heading appears.
Interact with the 'Rate your driver' interface if presented.
exit_criteria: The application reaches the 'Rate your driver' or 'Receipt' screen.

phases.title: Post-Ride & Activity History
phases.objective: Verify the receipt details and test the Activity tab functionality post-ride.
key_checks: Review the 'Receipt' screen for expected ride details.
Navigate to the 'Activity' tab via the bottom navigation.
Verify that the recently completed ride appears in the activity history.
exit_criteria: The 'Receipt' view is documented and the 'Activity' tab is verified.

coverage_targets.pages: Explore all dynamic states within index.html (Home, Ride Selection, Active Ride, Trip Complete, Receipt, Activity, Account).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise the destination input, quick select buttons, ride tier selection, and bottom navigation bar.
coverage_targets.mobile: Ensure interactions with small tap targets (arrows, icons) are specifically tested in the mobile viewport to confirm usability.

notes: Since this is a mobile fixture, pay close attention to how overlays, bottom sheets, or screen transitions are handled within the mobile frame viewport.
